title: Ok, after much work, I think I'm almost ready to give this it's own domain.
author: DuchessCupcakeGames
selftext:
I've been wiring tirelessly at getting this RPG to actually play like how I envisioned it. With some valuable recommendations and advice from this group, I think it's almost ready for me to purchase a domain name and call it a game. 

So far, Ferality has 85 maps, 5 faction narratives and story arcs, NPC story arcs that you can either hire or battle for their equipment, a thorough battle system with full on RPG math. Quests that back the main storyline, 8 different "Kindred" characters each with special abilities that effect how the game is played, all that fun rpg stuff.

With suggestions from this group, I've cut out the LLM hallucination language where it was mixing the game tone with the user interface too much, and animated each of the Kindred types so it's not just a floating picture of the avatar, even though it was originally text based. 

All those changes really made a difference. Thank you. I'm open and welcoming any feedback to improve it further. Thanks for your time ❤️

For anyone that wants to take a look, it's at ferality.lovable.app until I get a more permanent domain.

comments.author: BoltVnderhuge
comments.body:
The constant resizing of frames is jarring, you should try to make those fixed. 

It also suffers from AI loving to put way too much text and details. This makes your menus overwhelming. Like, every button does not need an explanation under it. Some things are obvious or easy to learn.

replies.author: DuchessCupcakeGames
replies.body: Thank you, that helps. I don't see things kind this because I'm coming from the place of wanting people understand the game, but maybe defaulting to not having the tutorial on or having it explain less or a combination of both is in order. I have the players handbook for anyone that wants to go deeper with all that stuff so it's not necessary to be so up front. That makes sense.

replies.author: Fuzzzy420
replies.body:
Have to disagree. The text gives the impressions of vibecoded UI. Just use toolips. 

What is the gameplay loop?
Why is the art so blurry?
I don't get what's happening at the beginning. Is that combat?

replies.author: DuchessCupcakeGames
replies.body: The blurryness is from the video capture, not the game. It's a text based rpg so there's going to be a lot of text no matter how I cut it. The video is just a click through, it's not supposed to be played that fast. But all feedback is helpful. If you're getting confused by it, you're probably not the only one. This is why it doesn't have it's own domain yet. The game is more about exploring, leveling up, getting cool weapons, hiring more party members, et cetera. It's not an arcade game, but I'm trying to give it more of a video game feel even though it's primarily an rpg text game.

comments.author: ceasarwolphanomusic
comments.body: Play test some more, reads complaints from players and make sure the players are 90% happy

replies.author: DuchessCupcakeGames
replies.body: That's the goal. Right now I'm literally collecting complaints 😉 I don't think it's ready by any means. I am trying to make a big concept as simple to play as possible. I have this whole thing mapped out with story arcs and questlines that explain the big mystery of the Kindred, how the world fell in the first place, why there are parties of people adventuring to begin with, all of that, but before I go deeper into each faction's story arc, I'm going back to the ddrawing board with the UI and asking for feedback so I can make it make more sense to someone coming in from the cold. I might do an intro movie that explains what is going on to get people interested in the plot first.

replies.author: ceasarwolphanomusic
replies.body: Cool, keep pushing bro, don't rush 😎💪

comments.author: GentlePace
comments.body: I did not know a vibecoded game could look this bad. Did you use claude flash beta 0.1?

replies.author: DuchessCupcakeGames
replies.body: Ok, while I'm looking for feedback, this sounds a little on the mean side. Can you be more specific? What would you suggest?

replies.author: GentlePace
replies.body: Honestly? Everything…the insane amount of text, text size difference, the bright blinding white in contrast to ps3 brown. Different fonts, animations that aren’t really animations. The game idea it self seems not thought out, it keeps going man…

comments.author: connected_user93
comments.body: You have to get replace those UI sounds asap. They sounds horrible

replies.author: DuchessCupcakeGames
replies.body: Copy that. On it. The sounds were a mistake. I put them in as a placeholder but they ruined it rather than helped. I'm working on the UI. I have a friend that does have UI as his job and I'm going to ask for his help. I agree it's needed. Feedback like this makes me rethink a few things which is also why I haven't published it officially yet.
